top_signals.title: Russia Sanctions Must Stay in Place, Says Dutch Defense Minister
top_signals.summary: As the war in Ukraine enters nears its fifth year, Dutch Defense Minister Dilan Yesilgoz-Zegerius says "it's very important to make sure that the sanctions" against Russia remain in place, so that Russian President Vladimir "doesn't get everything he needs to fund this war." She made the comments in an interview with Bloomberg Television from the Warsaw Security Forum on Monday. (Source: Bloomberg)
